name: Spicy Turkey Meatballs with Chili-Sesame Noodles, Pickled Carrot & Snap Peas (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.

Place vinegar, sugar, and salt in a small bowl, then stir to combine the pickling liquid. Place a ⅔-cup of the shredded carrot on a plate and set aside. Add remaining carrot to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tsp brown sugar
½ tsp salt
½ (10 oz) bag shredded carrots

instructions.primary_message: Place turkey, egg, bread crumbs, and spices in a medium bowl. Using your hands, mix well to combine. Using a rounded tablespoon measure, form the mixture into meatballs and place on another plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lb ground turkey
1 egg
½ cup panko bread crumbs
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add meatballs and cook, turning occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through, 6-8 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (1 inch) piece ginger root
½ small bunch green onion (scallion)
1 (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger. Place in a small bowl along with water, soy sauce, vinegar, chili-garlic sauce, oil, sugar, and sesame seeds. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp soy sauce
2 tbsp rice vinegar
chili-garlic sauce
2 tsp toasted sesame oil
2 tsp brown sugar
2 tsp sesame seeds

instructions.primary_message: Once the water is boiling, remove from heat, uncover, and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes (or prepare according to package instructions). Drain in a colander, return to the pot, and set aside.
While the noodles are cooking, trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Set aside.

When the meatballs are done, add 8 to the plate with the carrot. Add sauce to the skillet with the remaining meatballs and stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring often, until meatballs are coated in sauce, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.

When the noodles are done, remove 1 cup, cut into bite-sized pieces, and add to the plate with the carrot and meatballs; set aside. Add green onions, oil, chili-garlic sauce, and salt to the pot with the remaining noodles, then toss to coat. Cover to keep warm and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp toasted sesame oil
1 tsp chili-garlic sauce
⅛ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat another skillet over high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add snap peas, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender-crisp, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp toasted sesame oil
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message:
FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide plain noodles, shredded carrot, meatballs, and a ⅔-cup of snap peas between plates. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide spicy noodles, meatballs, sauce, and remaining snap peas between bowls. Top with pickled carrot and chopped cashews. Enjoy!
